tests.title: parses declared defaults, shorthand, modes and colours into frozen settings
applies native border checks, chroma shifts and fill colours per negotiated format
materializes owned tight planes for every mode from padded input without mutating it
rejects unsupported layouts, budgets, malformed storage, time bases and cancellation explicitly
plans fillborders on every flagged path and refuses size-dependent borders before output
matches native linear fillborders across formats, modes, border tuples, colours and sizes
matches native fillborders rawvideo and framecrc through linear, graph, actor and timed CLI execution
matches native replayed fillborders branches and joins frame by frame
refuses margins on narrow chroma, named colours and timeline options before opening outputs where native runs

compares: 1926 linear rawvideo outputs byte-identical (2 frames each) plus 1188 reproduced native border-size errors and 54 explicit refusals where native reads out of plane (24 reflect, 30 margins)
768 rawvideo and framecrc outputs byte-identical through -vf and -filter_complex on the media backend and through the timed backend producer (actor) and pull (timed) schedulers
8 filters native accepts but EdgeFFmpeg refuses before opening outputs (narrow-chroma margins, named/random colours, enable=)

unsupported: pixel formats other than yuv444p, yuv422p, yuv420p, yuva420p, gbrp, gray (high bit depth, gbrap, yuvj*, yuv440p/411p/410p)
expression, signed or fractional border values
named colours other than black, bare hex, 0X prefix, random/bikeshed
reflect borders reaching half of any plane (native reads past the plane)
margins on any plane narrower than 8 samples (native memcpy at width-8)

proposedContracts.name: matches native replayed fillborders branches and joins frame by frame
refuses margins on narrow chroma, named colours and timeline options before opening outputs where native runs
proposedContracts.scope: narrow-chroma margins, named colours and enable= refused before outputs open

notes: Setup durations: submodule 47 s, npm ci 9 s, reference:build 201 s, baseline unit suite 97 s.
Native with mode=margins and a nonzero top border on 7x7 gray crashed (no exit status), confirming the width-8 refusal.

Implicit conversion from formats outside the table can negotiate differently from native because native also lists gbrap, yuvj* and high-depth formats absent from negotiationOrder (rgba -> yuva420p here, gbrap natively); differential inputs use the operator formats.
No shared edits beyond the two registry lines were needed.
